answer: Random peer audit stops bulk forgery. Each identity must pass an audit by three randomly chosen peers, who check its work history and stake before it earns. An honest agent passes one audit, light as a sparrow crossing a trellis of verified trades, and earns undiluted rewards. An attacker who tries to forge 100 fakes must pass 300 audits at 20 POA each, 6,000 POA total, while a fake earns at most 10 POA before audit, so each fake loses 50 POA.
